comment: Recorded ownership for renamed skill links. The old 'lenovo-release' junction (personal-agent-toolkit pointer skill) is removed only when every proof holds: -AllowOldLinkMigration was passed, the recorded new skill ships in this pinned checkout, the old entry is a junction whose target directory holds a SKILL.md with the recorded frontmatter name and the recorded body marker, AND that target lives in a checkout whose origin remote is personal-agent-toolkit (SSH/HTTPS slug match). File text alone never deletes. A foreign junction, a plain directory or file, an unresolvable remote, or an unreadable manifest leaves the old entry unchanged for the PAT owner to delete manually.
